# Caffeine for Windows 11 — Project Documentation (LLM/AI Consumption)

## Summary

**Caffeine for Windows 11** is a lightweight (115 KB), zero-dependency, native Win32 system-tray utility that prevents Windows 11 PCs and displays from sleeping during user-selected countdown timers.

## Repository

- **URL:** https://github.com/abdul-karim-mia/caffeine-win
- **License:** MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- **Language/Runtime:** Rust (stable), `windows-sys` crate (0.59), pure native Win32 APIs — no .NET, no C/C++ runtime.

## Build & Install

### Prerequisites

- Rust toolchain (stable) — installed via [rustup](https://rustup.rs).
- Windows host with Win32 headers (or cross-compile via `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` / `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`).

### Commands

```bash
# Clone
git clone https://github.com/abdul-karim-mia/caffeine-win.git
cd caffeine-win

# Build optimized release binary (~115 KB .exe)
cargo build --release --locked

# Run unit tests
cargo test --release

# Clean build artifacts
cargo clean
```

### Release Profile

Defined in `Cargo.toml`:

```ini
[profile.release]
opt-level = "z"      # Optimize for size
lto = true           # Link-Time Optimization across crates
codegen-units = 1   # Single codegen unit for maximal optimization
panic = "abort"     # Strip panic unwinding for binary-size reduction
strip = true
```

## Source Layout

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/main.rs` | Win32 message loop, tray icon registration, left/right-click handlers, shutdown cleanup. |
| `src/icon.rs` | GDI+-based animated pie-clock renderer — blue → amber → red countdown slices. |
| `src/state.rs` | Timer lifecycle: step cycles (`Off → 15m → 30m → 1h → 2h → 4h → Indefinite → Off`), progress ratio, tooltip text, formatting helpers. |
| `src/keepawake.rs` | P/Invoke wrapper around `SetThreadExecutionState` (`ES_CONTINUOUS \| ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED \| ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED`). |
| `src/single_instance.rs` | Named-mutex gate ensuring single running instance. |
| `src/autostart.rs` | Registry `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run` toggle for login persistence. |
| `src/tests.rs` | 4 unit tests: cycle sequence, ticking decrement, indefinite mode edge-case, progress ratio range. |
| `src/lib.rs` | Module declarations / re-exports. |

## Usage

### Default Hot-Keys

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Left-click** tray icon | Cycle through timer presets. |
| **Right-click** tray icon | Pop-up context menu with quick-select and autostart toggle. |
| **Esc / Exit menu item** | Graceful shutdown — clears `SetThreadExecutionState` and restores normal power behavior. |

### Cycle Steps

| Order | Mode | Duration | Visual |
|-------|------|----------|--------|
| 0 | Off | — | Static icon |
| 1 | 15m | 900s | Blue pie shrink |
| 2 | 30m | 1800s | Blue pie shrink |
| 3 | 1h | 3600s | Blue→amber transition |
| 4 | 2h | 7200s | Amber pie shrink |
| 5 | 4h | 14400s | Amber→red transition |
| 6 | Indefinite | ∞ | Full blue glow |

## Web Presence (/web)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `index.html` | SEO-optimized static landing page with interactive simulator, dark theme, FAQ accordion. |
| `favicon.svg` | Inline SVG icon used in browser tabs, PWA manifest, and Apple touch-icon. |
| `og-image.png` | 1200×630 Twitter/OpenGraph social preview card (PNG for broad compatibility). |
| `og-image.svg` | Source vector editor file for the preview image. |
| `robots.txt` | Sitemap directive for crawlers. |
| `sitemap.xml` | Single-page sitemap. |
| `site.webmanifest` | PWA installability manifest. |

## SEO & Structured Data

### Meta Tags

```html
<meta property="og:image" content="https://caffeine-win.vercel.app/og-image.png">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
```

### JSON-LD

Two structured-data blocks are embedded in `index.html`:

1. `@type: SoftwareApplication` — app category, pricing (free), version, features, aggregate rating.
2. `@type: FAQPage` — 4 FAQ entries (keep-awake mechanism, no-install, cycling, comparison vs PowerToxs / legacy Caffeine).

## CI/CD

| Workflow | Trigger | Purpose |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | `push` / `pull_request` on `main` | Builds test binary, runs unit tests, verifies `.exe` size. |
| `.github/workflows/release.yml` | `push` to `main`, `workflow_dispatch`, or `v*` tag | Builds release binary, uploads SHA-256 checksums + `.zip` assets, auto-creates GitHub Release. |

## Versioning Policy

- Releases driven by `Cargo.toml`'s `version` field.
- Pushing to `main` either:
  - If `v<version>` tag does **not** exist → creates it and publishes a tagged GitHub Release.
  - If tag already exists → publishes to a rolling `latest` release.
- Manual trigger: Run `Release` workflow in GitHub Actions UI (`workflow_dispatch`).
